patch_description: Replace the ZZ gate at wires [4,5] with a CRZ gate to improve expressivity at this critical entangling link. The second prior program demonstrated that controlled parametrized gates (CRX, CRY) outperform simple Ising gates while maintaining parameter efficiency. This change applies the same principle to the [4,5] bottleneck which connects the two halves of the circuit. CRZ provides controlled-phase rotation which should better separate difficult samples (improving worst_group_margin from 0.27 to potentially 0.31+) without increasing parameter count.
